title: Deep displacement payload
description: Payload for sensor_type = deep_displacement. Inclinometer readings at a single depth point. Multiple depths from the same sensor at the same timestamp travel as separate messages.

depth_m.description: Depth of the reading, in meters.

tilt_x_mm.description: Tilt in mm along the X axis.

tilt_y_mm.description: Tilt in mm along the Y axis.

cumulative_tilt_mm.description: Cumulative tilt from baseline. Figure 4 of the paper plots this vs depth.
